To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a passive solar building design with low embodied energy construction materials and energy efficient equipments with integrated renewable energy systems for hot water, electricity, etc. is the best solution for energy efficient and sustainable development of building.

the passive design of the building, the use of low embodied energy building construction materials, the use of energy efficient electrical appliances, and the use of renewable energy technologies can be used to achieve the sustainable development of energy efficiency in a residential building.
the energy conservation in building sector through energy efficiency is the key to sustainable development of a country.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of energy efficient buildings using renewable energy technologies for their sustainable development.
the development of a sustainable energy system in buildings.
energy efficient buildings and the role of renewable energy technologies in achieving the energy efficiency of the building for its sustainable development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
energy efficiency in building is the need of the hour.
the energy conservation through energy efficient building design is the key to the future sustainable energy development.

the energy efficient building design, low energy building materials, energy efficient equipments and renewable energy technologies have to be integrated together for a sustainable development in the building sector.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a building with solar passive design and low embodied energy building material would be the most energy efficient building.
energy efficiency in the buildings can be achieved through passive solar building techniques, use of low embodied energy building material and use of integrated renewable energy systems.
the energy efficient building design with integrated renewable energy technologies would be the best solution for energy efficient buildings.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the building design, materials, equipments, and integrated renewable energy technologies have to be selected judiciously to make a building energy efficient.
energy conservation through energy efficient building design and construction is the most important and cost-effective approach for sustainable development of a country.

the energy efficient building design, usage of low energy materials, energy efficient equipments and integration of renewable energy systems can reduce the energy consumption in the building by 50% and can make the buildings nearly zero energy building.
